data.notes: October’s confirmed calendar mixes Marrakech rooftop and club electronics with diaspora travel parties, Gnawa/Hausa heritage, folklore parades and the first Marrakech Jazz Experience.

events.title: Marrakech International Hausa Gnawa Festival — 2nd Edition
events.summary: Founded by Hassan Hakmoun, the Marrakech International Hausa Gnawa Festival returns for its second edition. The official listing confirms the 15–17 October 2026 save-the-date in Marrakech.

events.title: Marrakech Folklore Days 2026
events.venueName: M Avenue, Jemaa el-Fna and city venues
events.summary: The eighth edition of Marrakech Folklore Days brings international folk groups, music, dance, workshops and parades across the city. The official site positions it as a major traditional-arts festival celebrating living heritage.

events.title: Alex Wann @ LEONE Discoteca Marrakech
events.summary: Alex Wann returns to Leone after a sold-out May appearance. The event is billed as his post-summer return to the Marrakech club floor.

events.title: GINTON @ LEONE
events.summary: Ginton plays Leone with a hybrid guitar-and-decks set moving between Afro rhythms and house. The event page notes his work with Drake and Gordo.

events.title: Marrakech Jazz Experience
events.venueName: Théâtre Meydene, M Square and Centre culturel NOJOUM
events.summary: The first Marrakech Jazz Experience presents concerts, masterclasses and free public sets across M Avenue and related venues. The programme highlights Urban Folklore, Othman El Kheloufi and Axel Camil Hachadi across the main concert nights.

events.title: SUPERVIBE @ LEONE
events.summary: Leone welcomes Supervibe for a deep, minimal and tech-house night. The confirmed lineup includes Rich NxT, Jacob Husley and Memed Awad b2b Moruki.

events.title: OUM — Dialddar
events.summary: Moroccan artist OUM presents Dialddar, a voice-and-percussion-led project of original songs in darija. The Institut français listing confirms the Marrakech date at Maison Denise Masson.

events.title: SOFUNKED IN THE SUN Marrakech Edition 2026
events.summary: SOFUNKED and Unlocked Marrakech present a multi-day music-holiday takeover with club events, beach-party programming and DJs. The listing highlights R&B, hip-hop, old-school, Afrobeats, dancehall and soulful house.

events.title: Tiefschwarz at Kabana Rooftop
events.summary: Ali Tiefschwarz brings Berlin-rooted underground electronic sounds to Kabana’s Roofloor. The event also includes an earlier Kabana Live Band set on the rooftop.

events.title: MEKTOUB RECORDS @ LEONE
events.summary: Mektoub Records makes its Leone debut with a live performance by Adassiya. Nawfal opens the night with raw, immersive rhythms.

events.title: Tasty Sounds Expérience
events.summary: Tasty Sounds pairs electronic DJ sets with a food-led dancefloor concept at Rôtisserie de la Paix. The confirmed DJ lineup includes ALEXIA, ARY b2b MAD, MMB, ODDITY and SUPERNOVA.

events.title: Le Comptoir Electronik @ LEONE
events.summary: Le Comptoir Electronik lands in Marrakech for a Halloween-night Leone takeover featuring Bassel Darwish’s Morocco debut alongside Samuele Trabelssi and Felix ID.

events.title: Jungle Party by Groover Club
events.summary: Groover Club returns to Palm Orchids for a limited-capacity daytime garden party. The confirmed lineup is Andrei Ciubuc, SUE and BKL.

events.title: Saint Lanvain at Kabana Rooftop
events.summary: Kabana hosts Saint Lanvain for a late-night Roofloor set after the venue’s live band warm-up. The listing bills the sound as melodic and Afro house.

events.title: Le Matin Records — Halloween Edition
events.summary: Le Matin Records hosts a Halloween edition at Rôtisserie de la Paix. The confirmed lineup lists LAMALICE, LIVER J, MENDY and UMA.

events.title: Raíces Vol. 3
events.summary: Raíces returns with a Cuban-salsa masterclass, live dinner set by Junes in trio format, and DJ Shedu playing salsa, son cubano, timba and bachata until midnight.

events.title: Jungle Groove by Groover Club
events.summary: Groover Club returns to Palm Orchids for an alcohol-free, limited-capacity 11:00–23:00 garden day party with Andrei Ciubuc extended set, SUE and BKL.

events.title: Sol Sundays at El Fenn
events.summary: El Fenn launches a sunset rooftop DJ residency with Shems / Elektrokesh, running every other Sunday; October dates are 11 and 25 October from 17:00 to 22:00.
